Neha / Aditya — forwarding the ask from Nebula. Quick summary and proposed approach so we can respond to Marta today:

Summary of requirements from Nebula:
- AI naming: "Nebula Analytics, its parents, subsidiaries, and affiliates"
- GL limits requested: $1M/$2M, E&O $2M, Cyber $2M
- They will accept a temporary COI for provisioning but want a final endorsement within 30 days, otherwise procurement will escalate.

Proposed internal path (two-step):
1) Sales confirms provisioning can proceed on receipt of a carrier-issued temporary COI/binder that names Nebula as Additional Insured and lists coverage limits.
2) Legal confirms that a carrier-issued endorsement adding AI + Waiver of Subrogation + Primary & Noncontributory can be obtained within 30 calendar days post-signature. If not, escalate to contracts leadership to sign an exception.

Action items:
- Neha: please confirm whether the endorsed language Nebula requests is acceptable from a risk perspective and whether the 30-day window is ok (or if we need a different fallback). Also flag any mandatory carveouts (IP/indemnity interplay).
- Aditya / Laura: confirm whether broker is engaged and can push for a temporary COI today. If not, confirm timeline for provisioning hold.

Let me know if you want me to loop in Legal Ops or Finance for a temporary provisioning exception. I will draft a short reply to Marta once we have ETA.

Hannah / Neha / Marta —

Quick note from the carrier side: we can issue a temporary binder / COI that lists Nebula Analytics as Additional Insured and shows the requested limits today — see attached temporary COI stub. The formal endorsement (ISO CG 20 10 or carrier equivalent for Additional Insured) typically takes about 15-21 business days to bind and issue, depending on carrier intake and underwriter review. If Waiver of Subrogation is required for WC, that may be handled separately depending on the carrier; for GL/E&O we can request Primary & Noncontributory and a Waiver of Subrogation endorsement concurrently but it sometimes extends the timeline by a few days.

Key notes / limitations:
- Some carriers decline AI on E&O policies; if E&O AI is required we may need to provide alternate proof or confirm an exceptions path.
- We will include the exact naming you requested. Please confirm if you need any additional entities (e.g., specific parent company).

Attachment: Binder_TempCOI_Nebula_0427.pdf (application/pdf)

I can push for expedited endorsement but need a sign-off from Redwood and confirmation that the 30-calendar-day window is acceptable.

— Evan Shaw

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear note and the signed Order Form. We can proceed with the two-step approach described below.

1) Temporary COI accepted for provisioning: our broker (cc'd) has issued a carrier binder/COI that lists Nebula Analytics as Additional Insured and shows the requested limits. That will allow your onboarding team to proceed.

2) Final endorsement ETA: broker indicates formal endorsement within ~15-21 business days; we will target 30 calendar days to align with your procurement ask and will escalate internally if there are delays.

3) Exceptions / E&O AI: if carrier cannot provide Additional Insured on E&O, we will flag it to you immediately and propose either (a) substitute evidence or (b) an executive approval to accept GL AI + E&O confirmation letter.

Next steps for Nebula:
- Please confirm acceptance of the attached temporary COI for provisioning.
- If you require any specific parent company naming beyond "Nebula Analytics, its parents, subsidiaries and affiliates" provide the full legal names.
